source_label: Melloni et al. 2023 (Cogitate protocol); Cogitate Consortium et al. 2025
source_locus: Melloni et al. 2023, "Differential predictions of the theories", prediction 2 (Decoding content of consciousness), pp. 4-5; analysis #1 (p. 11); Cogitate 2025 Fig. 2 and abstract ("limited representation of certain conscious dimensions in the prefrontal cortex")
condition: suprathreshold visual stimuli (faces, objects, letters, false fonts), task-relevant and task-irrelevant, 0.5/1.0/1.5 s
outcome_measure: decoding of the conscious content from prefrontal cortex (iEEG, MEG, fMRI) after onset
expected_result: content decodable in PFC, for task-irrelevant stimuli as well
locus_prediction: prefrontal cortex (and parietal) in tandem with high-level sensory cortex
timing_prediction: after onset, during the ignition window (~0.3-0.5 s)
distribution_prediction: consistent decodability across PFC and high-level sensory cortex for all consciously seen stimuli, task-relevant or not
auxiliary_assumptions: stimuli consciously seen throughout; PFC decoding treated as broadcast, not as post-perceptual processing
test_status: preregistered; partly supported (category decodable in PFC), challenged for identity/orientation
distinguishing_feature: P04: locus and necessity (PFC vs posterior decodability) | P08: locus and necessity (local visual recurrence sufficient vs PFC broadcast required) | P12: locus (TPJ vs PFC)
opposed_by: P04 only at the level of necessity (see notes)
notes: P01 and P04 can both be true; they oppose only on which locus is necessary for access

condition: as P01
outcome_measure: transient (phasic) prefrontal ignition at onset and again at offset
expected_result: a second ignition event at stimulus offset
timing_prediction: transient ignition ~0.3-0.5 s after onset and again after offset; activity-silent in between
distribution_prediction: amplitude and content-specific pattern maximal in onset and offset windows, minimal in between; temporal generalization between onset and offset bursts only
auxiliary_assumptions: offset is a change in conscious content and therefore triggers broadcast
distinguishing_feature: P05: timing (phasic onset/offset ignition vs sustained for duration) | P08: timing (100-300 ms local recurrence vs 300-500 ms prefrontal ignition) and locus
notes: the cleanest value-level opposition in the field: phasic at offset (GNWT) vs sustained without an offset event (IIT)
